title: Very disappointed
text: Very disappointed. According to all the reviews and advertising of this blanket this blanket doesn't shed or pill. Well, I must have gotten a bad one, just washed in cold water and low heat and I can't believe all the pills and shedding ! I just spent over an hour pulling off all the pills on this. In fact, it felt like I was pulling most of the blanket off. Totally unacceptable! Very disappointed because it was so soft and pretty pre wash. So much came off that it shed all over my shirt like dog hair. Contacting seller.
